entities.summary: Linda May Bartoshuk is an American psychologist. She was born in rural South Dakota in 1938. She is a Presidential Endowed Professor of Community Dentistry and Behavioral Science at the University of Florida. She is an internationally known researcher specializing in the chemical senses of taste and smell, having discovered that some people are supertasters.
